name: Adult Red Dragon
senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 23

abilities.name: Guarded Stance
abilities.description: While the dragon doesn't have half of its hit points or fewer, melee attack rolls against it are made with disadvantage.

abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
abilities.description: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

abilities.name: Sight Weakness
abilities.description: The dragon has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast *Scorching Ray*.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (1d10 + 8) slashing damage plus 5 (2d4) fire damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks): -

At will: *command*, *detect magic*, *scorching ray*

1/day each: *fireball*

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 60-foot cone must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 59 (17d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Commanding Presence
legendary_actions.description: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast *command* (cast at 2nd level). The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Fiery Rays
legendary_actions.description: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast *scorching ray*. The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Pounce
legendary_actions.description: The dragon moves up to half its speed, and it makes one Rend attack.
